name: Text Generation
description: Generating coherent text continuations or responses from a prompt, powering chatbots, writing assistants, and code completion.

name: Text Classification
description: Assigning a label or category to a piece of text, used for sentiment analysis and content moderation.

name: Text-to-Image
description: Generating an image from a natural-language text prompt.

name: Image-to-Text
description: Producing a text description or caption from an input image.

name: Automatic Speech Recognition
description: Transcribing spoken audio into written text.

name: Text-to-Speech
description: Synthesizing natural-sounding spoken audio from written text.

name: Translation
description: Converting text from one natural language into another.

name: Summarization
description: Condensing a longer document into a shorter summary while preserving key information.

name: Question Answering
description: Producing an answer to a natural-language question, optionally grounded in a supplied document.

name: Image Classification
description: Assigning a label or class to an entire image.

name: Object Detection
description: Locating and classifying multiple objects within an image.

name: Image Segmentation
description: Assigning a class label to every pixel in an image.

name: Text-to-Video
description: Generating a video clip from a natural-language text prompt.

name: Image-to-Video
description: Animating a still image into a short video sequence.

name: Visual Question Answering
description: Answering natural-language questions about the contents of an image.

name: Sentence Similarity
description: Measuring how semantically similar two pieces of text are, used for search and retrieval.

name: Feature Extraction
description: Converting raw input (text, image, audio) into a numeric embedding vector for downstream use.

name: Token Classification
description: Labeling individual tokens in a sequence, such as named-entity recognition.

name: Zero-Shot Classification
description: Classifying text or images into categories the model was not explicitly trained on.

name: Depth Estimation
description: Predicting the distance of each pixel from the camera in a single image, used in robotics and AR.

name: Robotics
description: Applying machine learning models to control, perception, and planning for physical robots.

name: Reinforcement Learning
description: Training agents to make sequential decisions by maximizing a reward signal through trial and error.

name: Time Series Forecasting
description: Predicting future values of a sequence based on its historical pattern.

name: Table Question Answering
description: Answering natural-language questions using structured data in a table.

name: Fill-Mask
description: Predicting a missing or masked word within a sentence.
